programs.name: MBA
programs.eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with minimum 50% aggregate marks; CAT/MAT/XAT/CMAT/NMAT score preferred.
programs.overview: A flagship postgraduate management program built around the ICFAI case-study methodology, offering specializations in Finance, Marketing, HR and Operations with industry mentorship.
programs.admission_process: Based on CAT/MAT/XAT/CMAT/NMAT score or the university's own entrance evaluation, followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview.

programs.name: M.Tech
programs.eligibility: B.Tech/B.E in a relevant discipline with minimum 55% aggregate marks; GATE score preferred.
programs.overview: A postgraduate engineering program offered with specializations in Computer Science & Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering and Electronics & Communication Engineering.
programs.admission_process: Based on GATE score or the university's own entrance test, followed by Personal Interview.

programs.name: MCA
programs.eligibility: Bachelor's degree with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level, minimum 50% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: A postgraduate computer applications program covering advanced programming, software engineering and applied computing.
programs.admission_process: As per ICFAI Tech School postgraduate admissions process.

programs.name: LLM (1 Year)
programs.eligibility: LLB/BA-LLB/BBA-LLB degree with minimum 50% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: A one-year postgraduate law program with research and dissertation components.
programs.admission_process: Merit-based on qualifying degree marks and Personal Interview.

programs.name: LLM (2 Years)
programs.eligibility: LLB/BA-LLB/BBA-LLB degree with minimum 50% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: A two-year postgraduate law program with specialization electives, research and dissertation components.
programs.admission_process: Merit-based on qualifying degree marks and Personal Interview; CLAT-PG counselling also considered for LLM admission.

programs.name: MA (Education)
programs.eligibility: Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: A postgraduate education program covering educational theory, research methods and specialization in education leadership/pedagogy.
programs.admission_process: As per ICFAI Education School postgraduate admissions process.
